decision: Provisional C+M baseline for subsequent comparisons: emission color plus newly rendered metal, trained with shared full cross-attention K/V and CAA weight zero.
basis: Project owner reviewed the fixed 36-image inference grid and judged the result to basically meet the C+M requirement.
limitations: No training sample contains both learned tokens; their joint behavior is inferred at generation time.
The owner decision is qualitative on three object nouns and three seeds, not a disentanglement metric.
The no-modifier condition uses the shared trained K/V checkpoint and is not a pristine base-model control.
